principles.text_en: A classic gives practitioners a word for something they were already suffering from but could not discuss cleanly.
principles.text_zh: 经典作品会给一种早已存在、却说不清楚的痛苦命名。

principles.text_en: It does not merely add knowledge. It flips a default decision: more people can be slower, 100% reliability can be wrong, the database can be a detail.
principles.text_zh: 它不是增加知识点，而是反转默认判断：加人可能更慢，100% 可靠性可能是错的，数据库可能只是细节。

principles.text_en: After reading it, an engineer facing the same situation makes a different trade-off.
principles.text_zh: 读完之后，工程师面对同一个场景，会做出不同取舍。

principles.label_en: Travel as a phrase or map
principles.text_en: The insight survives outside the book as a phrase, formula, metric, diagram, or named pattern.
principles.text_zh: 洞见能离开原书继续流通，变成一句话、一个公式、一个指标、一张图或一个模式名。

items.title: The Mythical Man-Month
items.author: Frederick P. Brooks Jr.
items.problem_en: Large software projects were planned as if person-months were interchangeable units.
items.problem_zh: 大型软件项目被当成可随意兑换的人月单位来计划。
items.insight_en: Software schedules are constrained by communication, learning, sequencing, and conceptual integrity.
items.insight_zh: 软件进度受沟通、学习、顺序依赖和概念完整性约束，不是简单人力相加。
items.reversal_en: Adding people to a late project can make it later.
items.reversal_zh: 向延期项目加人，可能让项目更晚。
items.why_en: It turned management folk wisdom into a memorable law and made coordination cost visible.
items.why_zh: 它把管理直觉变成可传播的定律，让协作成本第一次变得可见。

items.title: Peopleware
items.author: Tom DeMarco, Tim Lister
items.problem_en: Managers treated software productivity as a tooling or process problem.
items.problem_zh: 管理者把软件生产率主要看成工具或流程问题。
items.insight_en: The major bottlenecks in knowledge work are often sociological: focus, trust, turnover, and team formation.
items.insight_zh: 知识工作的主要瓶颈常常是社会性的：专注、信任、流失和团队成形。
items.reversal_en: Productivity is not produced by pressure; it is destroyed by interrupting the conditions that make thinking possible.
items.reversal_zh: 生产力不是靠压榨出来的，而是会被破坏思考条件的管理方式消耗掉。
items.why_en: It gave software managers permission to treat environment and team chemistry as first-class engineering variables.
items.why_zh: 它让工作环境和团队化学反应成为软件工程中的一等变量。

items.title: Code Complete
items.author: Steve McConnell
items.problem_en: Programming advice was scattered across folklore, language manuals, and personal taste.
items.problem_zh: 编程经验散落在民间传说、语言手册和个人偏好里。
items.insight_en: Construction is a discipline with evidence-backed techniques, not just typing code after design is done.
items.insight_zh: 构建本身是一门有证据、有技法的纪律，不只是设计完成之后的敲代码。
items.reversal_en: Low-level coding choices are high-leverage design decisions.
items.reversal_zh: 底层编码选择也会成为高杠杆的设计决策。
items.why_en: It consolidated everyday programming craft into a durable checklist for professional practice.
items.why_zh: 它把日常编程手艺整理成可以长期使用的专业清单。

items.title: Design Patterns
items.author: Erich Gamma, Richard Helm, Ralph Johnson, John Vlissides
items.problem_en: Experienced designers reused structures that teams could not name, teach, or debate precisely.
items.problem_zh: 有经验的设计师反复使用一些结构，但团队无法准确命名、教授或争论它们。
items.insight_en: A pattern language turns tacit design experience into shared vocabulary.
items.insight_zh: 模式语言把隐性的设计经验变成共同词汇。
items.reversal_en: The main contribution is not code reuse; it is communication reuse.
items.reversal_zh: 它最大的贡献不是代码复用，而是沟通复用。
items.why_en: After GoF, saying Observer or Strategy compressed a design discussion into a portable name.
items.why_zh: GoF 之后，说 Observer 或 Strategy，就能把一整段设计讨论压缩成一个可携带的名字。

items.title: Refactoring
items.author: Martin Fowler
items.problem_en: Teams treated design improvement as risky cleanup work postponed until later.
items.problem_zh: 团队把设计改进看成危险的清理工作，总是推迟到以后。
items.insight_en: Design can be improved through small behavior-preserving transformations, backed by tests.
items.insight_zh: 设计可以通过一系列保持行为不变的小变换持续改进，并由测试保护。
items.reversal_en: Good design is not only planned up front; it can be grown safely inside existing code.
items.reversal_zh: 好设计不只能预先规划，也可以在既有代码中安全生长出来。
items.why_en: It gave developers a vocabulary for changing structure without changing behavior.
items.why_zh: 它给了开发者一套改变结构而不改变行为的词汇。

items.title: Domain-Driven Design
items.author: Eric Evans
items.problem_en: Enterprise software drifted away from the business language it was meant to embody.
items.problem_zh: 企业软件越来越脱离它本该承载的业务语言。
items.insight_en: The model is not documentation around the code; the model is expressed in the code and the team's language.
items.insight_zh: 模型不是代码旁边的说明文档，模型应该体现在代码和团队语言里。
items.reversal_en: Ambiguity in language is not a minor communication issue; it is an architectural issue.
items.reversal_zh: 语言中的歧义不是小沟通问题，而是架构问题。
items.why_en: Ubiquitous Language and Bounded Context became decision tools for splitting software and teams.
items.why_zh: 通用语言和限界上下文变成了划分软件和团队的决策工具。

items.title: Clean Architecture
items.author: Robert C. Martin
items.problem_en: Application cores became dependent on frameworks, databases, and delivery mechanisms.
items.problem_zh: 应用核心反而依赖框架、数据库和交付机制。
items.insight_en: Dependencies should point inward toward policy, away from volatile details.
items.insight_zh: 依赖方向应该指向内层策略，而远离易变的细节。
items.reversal_en: The database is not the center of the architecture; it is a detail.
items.reversal_zh: 数据库不是架构中心，它只是细节。
items.why_en: It turned architecture from boxes on a diagram into dependency direction.
items.why_zh: 它把架构从画框图，变成了画依赖箭头方向。

items.title: A Philosophy of Software Design
items.author: John Ousterhout
items.problem_en: Teams confused small modules with simple systems.
items.problem_zh: 团队把小模块误认为简单系统。
items.insight_en: A deep module hides much complexity behind a simple interface; shallow modules push complexity onto callers.
items.insight_zh: 深模块用简单接口隐藏大量复杂性，浅模块把复杂性推给调用者。
items.reversal_en: More small pieces can increase complexity when each piece leaks too much surface area.
items.reversal_zh: 更多小块不一定更简单；如果每块都泄露太多接口，复杂性反而上升。
items.why_en: It gave engineers a sharper test for abstraction quality: depth, not just decomposition.
items.why_zh: 它给了工程师一个更锋利的抽象质量测试：看深度，而不只是看拆分。

items.title: The Pragmatic Programmer
items.author: Andrew Hunt, David Thomas
items.problem_en: Developers needed a portable professional stance across languages, tools, and methods.
items.problem_zh: 开发者需要一种跨语言、跨工具、跨方法论的职业姿态。
items.insight_en: A programmer's leverage comes from habits: ownership, feedback, automation, plain text, and deliberate learning.
items.insight_zh: 程序员的杠杆来自习惯：负责、反馈、自动化、纯文本和持续学习。
items.reversal_en: Professionalism is not a role granted by a company; it is practiced in daily technical choices.
items.reversal_zh: 专业性不是公司授予的职位，而是每天技术选择中练出来的东西。
items.why_en: It became a portable operating manual for becoming a better developer.
items.why_zh: 它成了很多开发者随身携带的职业操作手册。

items.title: The Art of Unix Programming
items.author: Eric S. Raymond
items.problem_en: Unix practice contained a living design tradition that was mostly transmitted informally.
items.problem_zh: Unix 实践中有一套活的设计传统，却主要靠口耳相传。
items.insight_en: Small composable tools, transparent data formats, and narrow interfaces can outperform large integrated systems.
items.insight_zh: 小而可组合的工具、透明的数据格式和窄接口，可以胜过庞大的一体化系统。
items.reversal_en: Power can come from refusing to build a grand system.
items.reversal_zh: 力量可以来自拒绝构建一个宏大的整体系统。
items.why_en: It made Unix philosophy explicit enough to be reused beyond Unix.
items.why_zh: 它把 Unix 哲学显性化，使它能离开 Unix 继续被复用。

items.title: Structure and Interpretation of Computer Programs
items.author: Harold Abelson, Gerald Jay Sussman, Julie Sussman
items.problem_en: Programming was often taught as language syntax rather than as a way to construct computational processes.
items.problem_zh: 编程常常被教成语言语法，而不是构造计算过程的方法。
items.insight_en: Programs are expressions of processes; abstraction is the central tool for controlling those processes.
items.insight_zh: 程序是过程的表达，抽象是控制这些过程的核心工具。
items.reversal_en: The important question is not what a language can do, but what mental model it gives you for building machines of thought.
items.reversal_zh: 关键问题不是语言能做什么，而是它给了你什么心智模型去建造思维机器。
items.why_en: It trained generations to see programming as language design, interpretation, and abstraction.
items.why_zh: 它训练一代人把编程看成语言设计、解释器和抽象的艺术。

items.title: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
items.author: Martin Kleppmann
items.problem_en: Teams selected databases, queues, caches, and logs as products instead of as trade-off bundles.
items.problem_zh: 团队把数据库、队列、缓存、日志当产品选择，而不是当一组取舍来选择。
items.insight_en: Data systems can be read through recurring trade-offs: reliability, scalability, maintainability, consistency, latency, and evolution.
items.insight_zh: 数据系统可以通过一组反复出现的取舍来阅读：可靠性、可伸缩性、可维护性、一致性、延迟和演化。
items.reversal_en: You are rarely choosing a database; you are choosing failure modes and future constraints.
items.reversal_zh: 你很少只是在选数据库；你是在选择故障模式和未来约束。
items.why_en: It unified databases, streams, replication, transactions, and derived data into one mental model.
items.why_zh: 它把数据库、流、复制、事务和派生数据统一进一个心智模型。

items.title: Site Reliability Engineering
items.author: Betsy Beyer, Chris Jones, Jennifer Petoff, Niall Richard Murphy, editors
items.problem_en: Operations was treated as heroic firefighting and reliability was pursued as an absolute.
items.problem_zh: 运维被当成英雄式救火，可靠性被当成越高越好。
items.insight_en: Reliability is an engineering and economic target managed through SLOs, toil budgets, automation, and learning from incidents.
items.insight_zh: 可靠性是工程和经济目标，需要通过 SLO、苦差预算、自动化和事故学习来管理。
items.reversal_en: 100% reliability is usually the wrong goal.
items.reversal_zh: 100% 可靠性通常是错误目标。
items.why_en: It turned reliability from virtue into a quantifiable contract between product velocity and operational risk.
items.why_zh: 它把可靠性从美德变成了产品速度和运维风险之间可量化的契约。

items.title: Software Engineering at Google
items.author: Titus Winters, Tom Manshreck, Hyrum Wright
items.problem_en: Programming advice failed to explain what happens when code lives for decades and thousands of engineers change it.
items.problem_zh: 普通编程建议无法解释代码活几十年、被成千上万人修改时会发生什么。
items.insight_en: Software engineering is programming integrated over time.
items.insight_zh: 软件工程是把编程放进时间里积分。
items.reversal_en: The hard problem is not writing code once; it is keeping a living codebase healthy over time.
items.reversal_zh: 难点不是把代码写出来一次，而是让一个活的代码库长期健康。
items.why_en: It reframed tools, culture, testing, deprecation, and large-scale change as time-management infrastructure.
items.why_zh: 它把工具、文化、测试、废弃和大规模变更重写为管理时间的基础设施。

items.title: Continuous Delivery
items.author: Jez Humble, David Farley
items.problem_en: Release was a painful, risky, late-stage event separated from daily development.
items.problem_zh: 发布是痛苦、危险、发生在末尾的大事件，与日常开发割裂。
items.insight_en: A deployment pipeline turns release into a repeatable, automated, low-risk flow.
items.insight_zh: 部署流水线把发布变成可重复、自动化、低风险的流动过程。
items.reversal_en: The safest release is often the smaller and more frequent release.
items.reversal_zh: 最安全的发布往往是更小、更频繁的发布。
items.why_en: It made delivery an engineering system instead of a calendar ceremony.
items.why_zh: 它把交付从日历仪式变成了工程系统。

items.title: Accelerate
items.author: Nicole Forsgren, Jez Humble, Gene Kim
items.problem_en: Organizations argued about delivery practices without shared outcome measures.
items.problem_zh: 组织围绕交付实践争论，却没有共同的结果度量。
items.insight_en: Software delivery performance can be measured with a small set of outcome metrics and linked to organizational capabilities.
items.insight_zh: 软件交付表现可以用少数结果指标衡量，并与组织能力关联。
items.reversal_en: Speed and stability are not opposites in high-performing organizations.
items.reversal_zh: 在高绩效组织里，速度和稳定性不是对立面。
items.why_en: It gave leaders evidence-backed metrics for arguing about engineering investment.
items.why_zh: 它给管理者一组有证据支持的指标，用来讨论工程投资。

items.title: The Phoenix Project
items.author: Gene Kim, Kevin Behr, George Spafford
items.problem_en: IT work was invisible, overloaded, and disconnected from business flow.
items.problem_zh: IT 工作不可见、过载，并且与业务流动脱节。
items.insight_en: IT can be managed as a value stream using the same flow, feedback, and learning principles as manufacturing.
items.insight_zh: IT 可以被看成价值流，用流动、反馈和学习原则来管理。
items.reversal_en: The bottleneck is often not a team attitude problem; it is the system's constraint.
items.reversal_zh: 瓶颈往往不是团队态度问题，而是系统约束所在。
items.why_en: It made DevOps legible to managers through story rather than doctrine.
items.why_zh: 它通过故事而不是教条，让管理者理解 DevOps。

items.title: Team Topologies
items.author: Matthew Skelton, Manuel Pais
items.problem_en: Org charts hid the real communication paths that shaped software architecture.
items.problem_zh: 组织架构图遮蔽了真正塑造软件架构的沟通路径。
items.insight_en: Teams are the fundamental unit of delivery, and cognitive load is a design constraint.
items.insight_zh: 团队是交付的基本单位，认知负载是组织设计约束。
items.reversal_en: You do not merely fit teams to architecture; you shape architecture by shaping teams.
items.reversal_zh: 不是只让团队适配架构，也可以通过塑造团队来塑造架构。
items.why_en: It turned Conway's Law into a practical organization design vocabulary.
items.why_zh: 它把康威定律变成了一套可操作的组织设计词汇。

items.title: The Goal
items.author: Eliyahu M. Goldratt, Jeff Cox
items.problem_en: Managers optimized local efficiency while the whole system still failed to deliver.
items.problem_zh: 管理者优化局部效率，但整个系统仍然无法交付。
items.insight_en: A system's throughput is governed by its constraint; improving non-constraints can be waste.
items.insight_zh: 系统吞吐由约束决定，优化非约束点可能只是浪费。
items.reversal_en: Keeping every resource busy can reduce the output of the whole system.
items.reversal_zh: 让每个资源都忙起来，可能降低整个系统的产出。
items.why_en: It gave operations and software teams a simple way to ask where improvement actually matters.
items.why_zh: 它给运营和软件团队一个简单问题：真正值得改进的瓶颈在哪里？

items.title: The Lean Startup
items.author: Eric Ries
items.problem_en: Startups wasted years building products nobody wanted.
items.problem_zh: 创业公司花几年时间构建没人需要的产品。
items.insight_en: A startup is a learning machine under extreme uncertainty; the unit of progress is validated learning.
items.insight_zh: 创业公司是在极端不确定性下运转的学习机器，进度单位是经验证的学习。
items.reversal_en: The first product is not for scaling; it is for learning what to build.
items.reversal_zh: 第一个产品不是为了规模化，而是为了学习到底该构建什么。
items.why_en: It made MVP, build-measure-learn, and validated learning mainstream product vocabulary.
items.why_zh: 它让 MVP、构建-度量-学习和经验证学习成为主流产品词汇。

items.title: Thinking in Systems
items.author: Donella H. Meadows
items.problem_en: People explained complex behavior with linear cause-effect stories.
items.problem_zh: 人们用线性因果故事解释复杂行为。
items.insight_en: Stocks, flows, feedback loops, delays, and boundaries often explain behavior better than individual intent.
items.insight_zh: 存量、流量、反馈回路、延迟和边界，常常比个体意图更能解释行为。
items.reversal_en: Bad outcomes can arise from well-intentioned actors inside a poorly structured system.
items.reversal_zh: 坏结果可能来自结构糟糕的系统，而不是坏人。
items.why_en: It gave non-specialists a compact language for feedback and leverage points.
items.why_zh: 它给非专业读者一套理解反馈和杠杆点的紧凑语言。

items.title: The Design of Everyday Things
items.author: Don Norman
items.problem_en: Users were blamed for errors caused by illegible objects and interfaces.
items.problem_zh: 用户为糟糕物品和界面造成的错误背锅。
items.insight_en: Good design makes possible actions visible, maps controls to outcomes, and gives feedback.
items.insight_zh: 好设计让可行动作可见，让控制和结果之间有映射，并提供反馈。
items.reversal_en: Many user errors are design errors.
items.reversal_zh: 很多用户错误其实是设计错误。
items.why_en: It made affordances, mappings, constraints, and feedback part of everyday product language.
items.why_zh: 它让可供性、映射、约束和反馈进入日常产品语言。

items.title: A Pattern Language
items.author: Christopher Alexander, Sara Ishikawa, Murray Silverstein, et al.
items.problem_en: Architecture knowledge lived in expert intuition and was hard for communities to reuse.
items.problem_zh: 建筑知识藏在专家直觉里，社区很难复用。
items.insight_en: A living environment can be designed through a network of named patterns, each joining problem, context, and solution.
items.insight_zh: 有生命力的环境可以通过一组命名模式来设计，每个模式连接问题、情境和解法。
items.reversal_en: A language of small reusable patterns can guide design better than one grand master plan.
items.reversal_zh: 一套小而可复用的模式语言，可能比一个宏大总规划更能指导设计。
items.why_en: It became the ancestor of software pattern thinking.
items.why_zh: 它成为软件模式思想的祖先。

items.title: The Cathedral and the Bazaar
items.author: Eric S. Raymond
items.problem_en: Serious software was assumed to require centralized closed planning.
items.problem_zh: 严肃软件被认为必须依靠封闭、中心化的规划。
items.insight_en: Open, frequent, peer-driven development can find bugs and improve software faster than a closed cathedral model.
items.insight_zh: 开放、频繁、同行驱动的开发，可以比封闭的大教堂模式更快发现问题并改进软件。
items.reversal_en: More visible work can be more reliable than more controlled work.
items.reversal_zh: 更可见的工作，有时比更受控的工作更可靠。
items.why_en: It gave open source a founding metaphor that travelled far beyond one project.
items.why_zh: 它给开源一个可传播的创世隐喻。

items.title: The Google File System
items.author: Sanjay Ghemawat, Howard Gobioff, Shun-Tak Leung
items.problem_en: Traditional distributed file-system assumptions did not match Google's large, failure-prone, append-heavy workloads.
items.problem_zh: 传统分布式文件系统假设不适合 Google 大规模、频繁故障、追加写为主的工作负载。
items.insight_en: Design can become simpler and more scalable when it is shaped around the real workload instead of a general ideal.
items.insight_zh: 围绕真实工作负载设计，而不是围绕通用理想设计，系统可以更简单、更可扩展。
items.reversal_en: Commodity machine failure is not an exception; it is the normal substrate.
items.reversal_zh: 廉价机器故障不是异常，而是默认运行基底。
items.why_en: It showed that accepting failure explicitly could unlock massive scale.
items.why_zh: 它展示了正面接受故障，反而能打开大规模系统空间。

items.title: MapReduce
items.author: Jeffrey Dean, Sanjay Ghemawat
items.problem_en: Only distributed-systems experts could reliably process huge data across large clusters.
items.problem_zh: 只有分布式系统专家才能可靠地在大集群上处理海量数据。
items.insight_en: Many data-processing jobs can be expressed as map and reduce while the runtime owns partitioning, scheduling, communication, and failure handling.
items.insight_zh: 大量数据处理任务可表达为 map 和 reduce，而运行时接管分区、调度、通信和故障处理。
items.reversal_en: Programmers write sequential-looking functions; the framework thinks in parallel.
items.reversal_zh: 程序员写看起来顺序的函数，框架负责并行思考。
items.why_en: It hid distributed complexity behind two primitives and changed big-data programming.
items.why_zh: 它用两个原语隐藏了分布式复杂性，改变了大数据编程。

items.title: Bigtable
items.author: Fay Chang, Jeffrey Dean, Sanjay Ghemawat, et al.
items.problem_en: Google needed one storage system that could serve very different products, data shapes, and latency demands at huge scale.
items.problem_zh: Google 需要一个存储系统，能在超大规模下服务不同产品、数据形态和延迟需求。
items.insight_en: A sparse, distributed, persistent multidimensional sorted map gives applications control over layout without forcing a relational model.
items.insight_zh: 稀疏、分布式、持久化的多维有序映射，让应用控制布局，而不强制关系模型。
items.reversal_en: General-purpose does not have to mean relational; it can mean a simpler model with explicit layout control.
items.reversal_zh: 通用不一定意味着关系模型，也可以是更简单但布局可控的模型。
items.why_en: It shaped NoSQL thinking and showed how storage APIs change when scale dominates.
items.why_zh: 它影响了 NoSQL 思维，展示了规模成为主导因素时存储 API 如何变化。

items.title: Spanner
items.author: James C. Corbett, Jeffrey Dean, Michael Epstein, et al.
items.problem_en: Global-scale systems were expected to choose between distribution and externally consistent transactions.
items.problem_zh: 全球规模系统通常被认为必须在分布式和外部一致事务之间取舍。
items.insight_en: Expose clock uncertainty as a first-class API and design protocols around it.
items.insight_zh: 把时钟不确定性暴露成一等 API，并围绕它设计协议。
items.reversal_en: Time is not just an implementation detail; it can be an architectural primitive.
items.reversal_zh: 时间不只是实现细节，它可以成为架构原语。
items.why_en: It reframed global consistency as a problem of explicitly budgeting uncertainty.
items.why_zh: 它把全球一致性重写为显式预算不确定性的问题。
